GROUNDING.why: Both get the decisive one right — the 2024 amendment killing per-scan accrual and confirming e-signature — but Report 1 renders more verified cells correctly, including Washington's retention rule that Report 2 simply omits, and it marks its own coverage boundary rather than presenting a partial map as complete.

OVERALL.why: Report 2 is the tighter read and gets the Illinois amendment right, but Report 1 answers the question you actually asked — every state accounted for, the five fields filled cell by cell for the four statutes that bite, penalties with their units, and an honest line between "no law here" and "I didn't research this" — which is the difference between a memo you can build a signup screen from and one you'd have to re-research.
